hero_description: Creating beautiful and functional web applications using SvelteKit, React, and TypeScript.
site_description: kamodigi is a one-person studio that turns the "wouldn't it be nice if…" of local communities into web apps and sites.
about_me_self_intro: I'm Takuya Kometani, a freelance engineer who mainly builds my own products. I specialize in the frontend and care a lot about UI/UX. I've been developing since 2020. I enjoy cycling and hope to live abroad someday.
works_description: A list of my work and projects.
privacy_description: How kamodigi.work handles personal information, and a disclosure of information sent to external parties (published under the Telecommunications Business Act of Japan).
privacy_intro: kamodigi (the "Site") handles the information of people who use the Site in accordance with this policy.
privacy_collect_heading: Information we collect and how we use it
privacy_collect_contact: The name, email address, and message we receive in an inquiry email are used only to reply to and handle that inquiry.
privacy_collect_access: When you view the Site, cookies and similar technologies automatically collect information such as the pages you view, the referrer, your approximate region, and the type of device and browser you use. We use this for access analytics and for displaying ads, and not to identify any specific individual.
privacy_collect_thirdparty: Except where required by law, we do not provide personal information to third parties without the person's consent.
privacy_cookie_body: Cookies are small pieces of data stored in your browser. On the Site, the Google services listed below use cookies. You can disable or delete cookies in your browser settings. You can still view the Site with cookies disabled, but some features may not work properly.
privacy_external_intro: For the services below, the Site sends information from the visitor's browser to external companies (disclosed under Article 27-12 of the Telecommunications Business Act of Japan).
privacy_ga_data: The URL and title of the pages you view, the referrer (including source information attached to links such as ad QR codes), the date and time of viewing, your approximate region estimated from your IP address, the type of device, OS, and browser, your screen size, an identifier stored in a cookie, and your actions on the Site (such as clicks on the contact links)
privacy_ga_purpose: To understand how the Site is used and help improve its content and operation
privacy_ga_optout: You can stop data from being sent to Google Analytics by installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on in your browser.
privacy_adsense_data: The URL of the pages you view, the referrer, the date and time of viewing, your IP address, the type of device, OS, and browser, and an identifier stored in a cookie
privacy_adsense_purpose: To display ads, show ads matched to the viewer's interests, and measure how effective ads are
privacy_adsense_optout: You can turn off personalized ads in Google's ad settings (My Ad Center).
privacy_google_partner: How Google uses information it receives from partner sites is explained in "How Google uses information from sites or apps that use our services."
privacy_contact_body: For questions about this policy and how information is handled, please write to the email address below.
privacy_changes_body: We may revise this policy to reflect changes in law or in how the Site is run. Revisions take effect when they are posted on this page.
contact_description: Whether it's a website, frontend development, or an invitation to collaborate, feel free to get in touch. Technical discussions and feedback are welcome too!
privacy_translation_notice: This page is a translation of the Japanese version. The Japanese version is the authoritative text; if the translation differs from it, the Japanese version prevails.
